product.title: Western Everglades Adventure Tour

description.text: Escape to the Florida Everglades from the Greater Naples area on this guided airboat adventure at Everglades Day Safari. This exciting airboat ride is a great way to experience the ecosystem of the Everglades. Skim across the marshes and swamps of the Western Everglades while looking for wildlife, namely birds and alligators. Ideal for Naples travelers who want a guided Everglades outing with transport, mangrove channels, and expert naturalist commentary included.
